title: Converted tester uses three-literal clauses
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every E3-Lin sign tester on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, each predicate used by its converted E3-Sat tester is a three-literal clause: it accepts exactly when at least one of the three queried signs differs from its corresponding falsifying sign.
hypotheses_covered: An E3-Lin sign tester on the n-dimensional Boolean cube
